episodes.title: Failure's Contagious
episodes.summary: River Cartwright is ousted from MI5 and finds himself in a place worse than purgatory: Slough House, dumping ground for failed spies.

episodes.title: Work Drinks
episodes.summary: River and Sid join forces. A misfired gun has dire consequences.

episodes.title: Bad Tradecraft
episodes.summary: Slough House is the unlikely venue for a secret romance, but events take a dark turn when a dangerous encounter becomes deadly.

episodes.title: Visiting Hours
episodes.summary: Taverner sends the Dogs to hunt down Lamb and the Slow Horses. River holds the secret to saving the gang.

episodes.title: Fiasco
episodes.summary: The Slow Horses must disappear to avoid capture by MI5. Lamb and River head to The Park to outwit Taverner.

episodes.title: Follies
episodes.summary: Taverner and the Slow Horses attempt different approaches to locate the kidnappers and Hassan. Ho makes a shocking discovery about Sid.

episodes.title: Last Stop
episodes.summary: Jackson Lamb is on high alert after a former spy is found dead. Min and Louisa are tempted by an offer from outside Slough House.

episodes.title: From Upshott with Love
episodes.summary: Lamb liaises with a Russian defector who may hold a clue to sleeper agents. River is on the trail of a ruthless assassin.

episodes.title: Drinking Games
episodes.summary: River gets cozy in the Cotswolds while searching for a sleeper agent. Min discovers Russian drinking games are the most brutal of all.

episodes.title: Cicada
episodes.summary: Louisa makes her move on Pashkin. Catherine makes moves of a different kind when she plays high-stakes chess with a sinister stranger.

episodes.title: Boardroom Politics
episodes.summary: Lamb orders his Slow Horses to walk into traps. River believes something alarming is heading toward London.

episodes.title: Old Scores
episodes.summary: Season finale. Lamb and Katinsky go head-to-head. Ho finds himself trapped on a train with a Russian assassin.

episodes.title: Strange Games
episodes.summary: A romantic relationship in Istanbul ends badly. Lamb hits the panic button when one of his Slow Horses fails to show up for work.

episodes.title: Hard Lessons
episodes.summary: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

episodes.title: Negotiating With Tigers
episodes.summary: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests
episodes.summary: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

episodes.title: Cleaning Up
episodes.summary: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Footprints
episodes.summary: Season finale. The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

episodes.title: Identity Theft
episodes.summary: A London bombing puts Taverner under pressure. When River grows concerned for his grandfather, Louisa encourages him to go for a visit.

episodes.title: A Stranger Comes to Town
episodes.summary: A naive agent makes a discovery about the Westacres bomber. Lamb suspects that David knows more than he's letting on.

episodes.title: Penny for Your Thoughts
episodes.summary: River is trapped in France. Back at Slough House, the Dogs have come for Lamb.

episodes.title: Returns
episodes.summary: Taverner is desperate to hide dangerous secrets. River seeks answers at his grandfather's house.

episodes.title: Grave Danger
episodes.summary: Lamb questions David about France as River comes face to face with the enemy.

episodes.title: Hello Goodbye
episodes.summary: Season finale. Impossible decisions are faced and sacrifices are made.

episodes.title: Bad Dates
episodes.summary: A mass shooting rocks London, intensifying a testy mayoral race. Shirley believes one of the Slow Horses was the target of an attempted hit.

episodes.title: Incommunicado
episodes.summary: Lamb intercepts an assassin. Taverner receives a key piece of intel about the Abbotsfield shooting.

episodes.title: Tall Tales
episodes.summary: An act of sabotage grinds London to a halt. Taverner interrogates Roddy. Coe is convinced a destabilization strategy is at play.

episodes.title: Missiles
episodes.summary: Flyte sets out to find Roddy's girlfriend. The gang is dispatched to two different campaign events to prevent another attack.

episodes.title: Circus
episodes.summary: Lamb debriefs River and Coe. Roddy is pulled in to help decipher a piece of code as the destabilization strategy nears its final stage.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.summary: Season finale. It's up to the Slow Horses to stop Farouk's team from completing its mission in a final act of mass carnage.
